question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

Impossible to change or reverse
solution:
The correct answer is: **Irrevocable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• '**Irrevocable**' means impossible to change or reverse. (अपरिवर्तनीय)
 
• It is an adjective and is often used to describe decisions, contracts, or agreements.
 
• The word is derived from the Latin word 'revocare
